Glass Impression.name: Glass Impression
Glass Impression.description: The user kneels on dry ground and blows fine mineral grains into a recess within arm's reach until they fill every groove. The user spins and presses the outer layer into a thin glass shell and draws the loose grains back out. In one turn the user lifts a cast that shows by touch where a hidden fitting has bent or a catch has slipped. The cast lasts for the scene if handled gently. The fitting must stay still until the shell comes free or the glass breaks. Strain: severe.
